about: Ekitag (エキタグ, jeki's NFC digital station stamps) at stations on the catalogue's five lines in Niigata, from JR East Niigata branch press releases. ekitag.jp publishes only counts per prefecture (新潟県 50駅 on 2026-07-31), so stations added after the last release here are not covered.
